title: ACT
subtitle: Enhanced ACT
description: Practice English, Math, Reading, and optional Science using the updated ACT structure.

topics.title: English
topics.description: Revise sentences for grammar and clarity.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct verb: "The team of engineers _____ ready to begin."
questions.explanation: The singular subject team takes the singular verb is.

options: After the storm the street was quiet.
After the storm, the street was quiet.
After, the storm the street was quiet.
After the storm the, street was quiet.
questions.explanation: An introductory phrase is commonly followed by a comma.

topics.title: Math
topics.description: Practice algebra, geometry, and problem solving.

questions.prompt: What is the slope of the line through (2, 1) and (6, 9)?
questions.explanation: Slope = change in y ÷ change in x = (9 − 1) ÷ (6 − 2) = 8 ÷ 4 = 2.

questions.prompt: A rectangle measures 8 inches by 5 inches. What is its perimeter?

topics.title: Reading
topics.description: Find key details and reasonable inferences.

questions.prompt: Passage: Lena repaired an old bicycle rather than buy a new one. She replaced the chain and adjusted the brakes so she could use it to commute. Which statement is supported?
options: Lena intends to ride the repaired bike.
questions.explanation: The passage explicitly says Lena repaired the bike to use it for commuting.

questions.prompt: Passage: Residents created a neighborhood garden on an empty lot. Volunteers donated seeds, installed raised beds, and shared the harvest. What best describes the project?
options: A commercial farm run by one company
A volunteer project that benefits neighbors
A plan to close the lot permanently
questions.explanation: The volunteers worked together on a shared garden and harvest.

topics.title: Science (optional)
topics.description: Interpret experimental results, charts, and evidence.

questions.prompt: In an experiment, a plant grew 2 cm at 10°C, 4 cm at 20°C, and 6 cm at 30°C over the same period. What pattern is shown?
options: Growth increases with temperature in these trials.
questions.explanation: The recorded growth rises from 2 to 4 to 6 cm as temperature increases across these trials.

questions.prompt: Two identical seedlings get the same light and water. One receives fertilizer and the other does not. Which variable is intentionally changed?
questions.explanation: Fertilizer is the independent variable; the other conditions are kept the same.
